description: Bubble that shows a piece of a conversation and identifies its source.

howToUse: Use it for one piece of a conversation: a message, a quick reply, a system notice in a chat.
Set `side` to tell who speaks: the person on one side, the other party on the other.
alternatives: A message with author, time and state: Message.

keyboard.action: The bubble does not receive focus. Links inside it do.

props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
